routine.title: Home core + mobility
routine.note: The 15-minute home core + mobility block, in order. Plus 5-a-side football in the evening (cardio).

routine.title: Full body A (push + pull + legs) + Treadmill run
routine.note: Antagonist pairs done back-to-back: 30–60 s between the two halves, ~90 s before the next round. Two light warm-up sets on the first movement of each pair. Double progression — top of the range on all 3 sets → add weight and reset reps; below the bottom → drop about 10%. All working sets 8–12 reps unless stated; calves and carries 12–15. Calf press on the leg press, straight after each leg-press set. Treadmill run AFTER the lifts, easy pace, distance ramping toward the 10k goal.

routine.title: Parkrun + Full body C (push + pull + legs)
routine.note: Parkrun 5 km FIRST — run slower than feels natural, short stride, high cadence, 'run tall, tuck the pelvis'. Then the gym session. Antagonist pairs done back-to-back: 30–60 s between the two halves, ~90 s before the next round. Two light warm-up sets on the first movement of each pair. Double progression — top of the range on all 3 sets → add weight and reset reps; below the bottom → drop about 10%. All working sets 8–12 reps unless stated; calves and carries 12–15. Standing calf raise on a step in the last pair.
